output.headline: Midwest-weighted provider sponsor that already bought a Healthcare Services bolt-on in the region, with a median deal size near the target's $200M.
output.differentiator: Joint-highest Midwest deal count on the priority list (6, level with Welsh Carson) and a $173M median deal close to the target's size, backed by a same-sub-sector Midwest bolt-on.
output.why_them: Midwest provider sponsor; same-sub-sector bolt-on precedent; size fits

acquirer_overview.title: Provider-focused sponsor with a Midwest-weighted 14-deal record
points: Financial sponsor with 14 deals from 2015 to 2023; 11 of 14 (79%) closed and 12 of 14 (86%) were control deals [T:record, K:closed_share, K:control_share].
Mandate includes healthcare; latest fund is Fund XIV at $11.5 billion, ample against a $128M equity cheque [P:1, P:2, V:lbo].
Ranks 8th on the priority list of 10, with a likelihood of 3.8% among 107 buyers scored [R:rank].

strategic_fit_thesis.title: A Midwest provider sponsor with a same-sub-sector bolt-on precedent
points: Platform Build in 5 of 14 deals and Margin Improvement in 6 of 14 suit a target with a 16.8% margin [M:platform_build, M:margin_improvement].
Midwest history (6 deals) is the largest factor in its likelihood, though only a modest one [S:geo_fit, T:record].
Provider specialist with size fit: 9 of 14 deals are provider deals, 8 in adjacent sub-sectors, but it has no open platform [A:angles, T:record].

precedent_activity.title: Sterling is the closest precedent; Midwest deals dominate
points: Sterling Health Systems: $911M Bolt-on Acquisition, 2018, Midwest, 12.2x, closed, in the target's own sub-sector [D:MA-2018-0357].
Golden Orthodontics: $588M Leveraged Buyout, 2020, Midwest, 15.2x, closed [D:MA-2020-0276].
Zenith Specialty Care, a $76M Midwest bolt-on at 8.9x in 2023, was withdrawn [D:MA-2023-0279].

valuation_context.title: Upper-quartile pricing is defensible; return at the ask is the gap
points: Comparable range is 10.7x to 15.3x, median 12.8x; the 75th percentile is defensible as the 16.8% margin beats the comps' median of 12.9% [V:comps].
GTCR's own median paid is 15.2x, close to the 75th percentile of 15.3x [V:comps].
IRR at the ask is 18.7% versus a 20% target; maximum price is $193M at the same exit, $216M at a 15.0x platform exit [V:lbo].

risk_flags.title: Return at the asking price
risk_flags.concern: IRR at the ask of 18.7% is below the 20% target [V:lbo].
risk_flags.mitigant: A platform exit at 15.0x lifts the maximum price to $216M [V:lbo].
risk_flags.reality: The bid works only if it underwrites an add-on exit; the same-exit ceiling is $193M [V:lbo].

risk_flags.title: Execution record
risk_flags.concern: 11 of 14 deals closed, and Zenith Specialty Care was withdrawn in 2023 [K:closed_share, D:MA-2023-0279].
risk_flags.mitigant: Its closed Midwest deals include Sterling Health Systems and Golden Orthodontics [D:MA-2018-0357, D:MA-2020-0276].
risk_flags.reality: Close rate is a slight factor against its likelihood [S:close_rate_s].

risk_flags.title: No open platform
risk_flags.concern: No open platform in the sub-sector, and only 1 deal in the target's own sub-sector [A:angles, T:record].
risk_flags.mitigant: Eight adjacent provider deals and the Sterling bolt-on show it can enter new areas [T:record, D:MA-2018-0357].
risk_flags.reality: Peers with open platforms may offer a cleaner add-on story to the seller [A:angles].

conviction.rationale: One deal in the target's own sub-sector and eight in adjacent provider sub-sectors support the case; the absence of an open platform in the sub-sector keeps it at Medium [C:conviction].
